name: Serpentico Smash
review:
Serpentico Smash is a 6x5 Mesoamerican cluster slot where winning symbols and scatters crush the symbols beneath them.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.18%.

The crush mechanic means winners smash the symbols beneath them instead of simply disappearing, which changes how the next cascade lands.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
